source.title: The 8 Best Cafes in Busan: My Top Coffee Spots in 2026

hooks: Visited Tide Roasters right before sunset, watching the sun drop behind the bridge (source article)
Outdoor tables at Thrill on the Mug were closed due to strong winds (source article)
Ordered the falafel nourish bowl at Little Aus (source article)

list.title: Best cafes in Busan: Girl on a Zebra's 8 coffee spots
list.desc: Places from Girl on a Zebra's 'The 8 Best Cafes in Busan: My Top Coffee Spots in 2026' (https://girlonazebra.com/best-cafes-in-busan/). Collected by PinWith, not made by Girl on a Zebra.

items.title: Tide Roasters (타이드)
items.memo: Long ocean-facing bar for about a dozen; lovely right before sunset.

items.title: Coralani (코랄라니)
items.memo: Tiered decks over the sea near Haedong Yonggungsa; pricier than average.

items.title: Little Aus
items.memo: Australian-style brunch and flat whites; falafel nourish bowl with hummus.

items.title: Chaseonchaek (차선책)
items.memo: Black sesame cake and injeolmi lattes by Gwangalli; gluten-free options.

items.title: Working Holiday
items.memo: Bright beach-facing windows, good for a laptop or just relaxing.

items.title: Thrill on the Mug (스릴온더머그)
items.memo: Stadium-style seats on the cliffs; outdoor tables shut in strong wind.

items.title: Having Moment (해빙모먼트)
items.memo: Warehouse interior with sea and skyline views; strong, fairly priced coffee.

items.title: Jeonpo Cafe Street (전포카페거리)
items.memo: Walkable street of coffee shops that smells of roasting beans.

message.subject: I listed your Busan cafe guide on one map
message.body:
Hi Carae, I'm Adrian from PinWith, a map-list app.

Catching Tide Roasters right before sunset, with the sun dropping behind the bridge, sounds like the perfect timing. I put 8 of the places into one map: https://pinwith.me/@pinwith_en/girlonazebra-busan-cafes

It's private for now: only this link opens it, and I'll delete it if you'd rather I didn't.

With PinWith, your readers can follow in your footsteps: revisit the places you went or plan their own trip from one map, in their own language. That helps your content reach further.

If you like it, I'll move it to your account, credited to you, so you can link it in the post. Lists like this can also earn curators extra income: https://pinwith.me/for-creators?lang=en
No reply needed if it's not useful.

Adrian
